items.name: All Events in Stockholm 2024
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till All Events in Stockholm 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **"tävlingsformat"**. Hoppas vi ses på tävlingen!

--

A warm welcome to All Events in Stockholm 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the tab **"competition format"**. We are looking forward to see you at the competition!

items.name: Niner Nation Silence 2024
items.information:
**NOTE: THERE IS NO STANDARD 3x3x3 CUBE EVENT HELD AT THIS COMPETITION. All competitors at all skill levels are welcome, however most of the events held at the competition are more advanced. The only two sighted events are 6x6x6 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube. The rest of the events are blindfolded or 3x3 Fewest Moves (which is writing out a solutition to a scramble in 1 hour). We will NOT be teaching competitors how to do these events. Competitors are expected to know how to compete in the events they register for.**

Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us.
All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed.

**No outside food or drink is allowed in the venue**

items.name: Honolulu Nui a Makapo 2024
items.information:
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/578431091522797600/1156783553196085308/311822565_10159863148208791_5265841507458045856_n.png)
### The competition weekend in Hawai'i continues with an amazing side events competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

### This competition will be specializing in niche events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Li'ili'i a 'Ike Maka 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HonoluluLiiliiaIkeMaka2024), happening on January 27th, the day before.
